result.summary: Identified a few minor UI formatting issues, primarily related to text truncation and padding.

issues.description: Text for 'Trattoria Piccolo' truncates abruptly without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Implement standard text-overflow with an ellipsis for long titles.

issues.description: Subtitle text in the green promo banner is small and lacks contrast.
issues.suggestion: Increase subtitle font size or contrast.
